exposure: Sequential transfer of one cleavage-stage embryo on day 3 and one blastocyst on day 5
cohort: 2836 frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles in patients with repeated implantation failure (RIF)
finding: Sequential embryo transfer did not improve implantation rate, clinical pregnancy rate, or live birth rate compared to two blastocyst transfer in patients with repeated implantation failure, but it resulted in higher clinical pregnancy rate, multiple pregnancy rate, and live birth rate compared to single blastocyst transfer.
